note: Missing purpose — the only required request member.
Empty purpose string — the field names a category, not an empty answer.
Unknown top-level payload member — additionalProperties: false catches `note`.
proposedIdentifier as an empty string — a producer that has no identifier to propose omits the member entirely rather than sending an empty one.
proposedIdentifier that is not a DID — the identifier the engagement would continue under must be resolvable and verifiable, so the schema requires the `did:` scheme.
